create.name: Kali Basman
create.bio:
Kali Basman is a Yin Yoga educator and dharma teacher based in Boulder, Colorado, who has been teaching for around eighteen years and also works under the name Kali Durga. Her root teacher is Sarah Powers, and like her she joins slow, long-held Yin postures with Buddhist meditation and inquiry. Into that mix she brings the meridians and Five Element theory of Chinese medicine and a detailed interest in anatomy and fascia, so a class moves between the body's tissues, the breath and the mind. She holds a master's degree in public health from UCLA, and earlier work in conscious dying and sacred passage shapes the way she speaks about grief and change.

She trains yoga teachers through a residential Five Elements Yin and Restorative course in Mexico and a three-month online advanced course, and she leads silent and yoga retreats at centres such as Drala Mountain Center in Colorado. In Boulder she teaches weekly flow and Yin classes, several of them streamed live. Her website holds a free archive of dharma talks and guided meditations recorded on retreats, alongside short on-demand practice series. She also teaches at yoga festivals and is writing a book on Yin Yoga and the inner life.

courses.title: 5 Elements Yin & Restorative Yoga Teacher Training (Haramara, Mexico)
courses.description: A week-long residential primary training in Yin and Restorative Yoga at Haramara in Sayulita, with mornings held in silence. Each day explores one of the Five Elements of Chinese medicine through anatomy, sequencing, meridians and Buddhist practice, and it counts as 50 hours of continuing education.
courses.price: $2288 (female-only dorm) to $4450 (private cabana) per person, including tuition, meals and accommodation

courses.title: Virtual Advanced Yin Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A three-month online course of pre-recorded lessons that spends a fortnight on each element in turn, opening and closing with live ceremonies. It layers physical, emotional and energetic practice, from Yin anatomy and breath to mindfulness and Buddhist teachings, with lifetime access to the material.

courses.title: Healing the Heart Silent Zen Retreat (Drala Mountain Center)
courses.description: A weekend silent retreat combining yoga and Zen-style meditation at Drala Mountain Center in Red Feather Lakes, Colorado. Registration is through the retreat centre.

courses.title: Coming Home to Center Retreat (Drala Mountain Center)
courses.description: A five-day yoga retreat at Drala Mountain Center in Colorado focused on finding steadiness at the core of the body and mind. Registration is through the retreat centre.

courses.title: Virtual Mini-Courses
courses.description: Short on-demand practice series to use at home: a Five Elements journey through the meridians, an organ-focused Yin series, a heart-centred Zen meditation series and a set of five Yin classes, among others.

courses.title: Weekly Yoga Classes in Boulder and Online
courses.description: Her regular flow and Yin classes at Yoga Pod in Boulder, most of them also live-streamed so people elsewhere can join. Booking is through the studio.
courses.price: Yoga Pod new students: $40 for one month of unlimited classes

free_resources.title: Dharma Talks & Meditations
free_resources.description: A free archive of dharma talks and guided practices recorded on her retreats and at studios, on themes such as loving-kindness, the open heart, Lojong mind training and steadying the breath.
